Q11.drivers: Same profile organization as Q09: bulging rounded upper trunk, pinched waist, forward-jutting thigh, knee kink and strong calf bulge; broad shoulders over thin limbs

Q12.drivers: Rectangular, slab-like trunk with no waist, flat planar front; very deep, boxy profile trunk that overhangs the thigh with an abrupt step; thick columnar legs; heavy, squat-looking proportions

deep boxy barrel/slab trunk overhanging the legs (squat heavy type)

distinguishing_features: Q09/Q11: rounded, bulbous upper trunk with a narrow pinched waist, thin limbs, and a forward-jutting thigh with a knee kink and strong calf bulge (slightly bent-knee read). Q12 (and probably Q02): a rectangular, very deep boxy trunk with no waist that overhangs comparatively columnar legs at an abrupt pelvic step, with no knee flexion. Q02 is uncertain because it could also be read as an obese human, which is why that group is marked unstable.
